d: What if a drone could evacuate a wounded soldier from a dangerous battlefield in minutes? Ukraine's SkyFall has developed Stargate, an aerial medical evacuation drone designed to carry up to 150 kilogrammes over a one-way range of 15 kilometres. Equipped with AI functions to help it respond to navigation disruptions and potential threats, the drone is now being evaluated by a Ukrainian combat brigade. Could Stargate help get wounded soldiers to safety when traditional rescue missions are too dangerous?
